verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair privacy question for a SaaS collaboration product like Basecamp, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, analytics, tracking controls, or any opt-out setting. The pack covers features, pricing, API, CLI and MCP support, none of which address this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
